flags.why: The Vietnamese addresses the learner as 'you' and says they are already late, whereas the translation says 'we' will be late.
flags.fix: Why are you taking so long? You're already late for school!

flags.why: Applied to a person, this disparages their mental state or temperament and needs a derogatory warning ([definition](https://loigiaihay.com/do-do-uong-uong-la-gi-y-nghia-thanh-ngu-do-do-uong-uong-a178887.html)).
